description: Search intent of up to 100 keywords in one $0.04 call: the main intent (informational, navigational, commercial or transactional) with its probability, plus secondary intents. Use when you need to map keywords to funnel stage or content type. Any language; no location needed. Over 100 keywords is a free 400. Keywords not classified are listed in missing (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

keywords.description: Keywords to classify (1-100; each at most 80 characters, normalised to lower case; one that is then empty, over 10 words or over 80 characters is listed in missing).

languageCode.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored: the classifier detects the language itself.

name: search_intent
title: Search intent (up to 100 keywords)
